8-UNITNING OXIRGI BETI (59-bet).

Yuqorida o'ngda 'A Brush with Danger' va BINAFShA yorliqda oq '8'.

CHAP USTUN:
• Pushti nuqta va to'q sariq 'Communication: Apologising'.
22) Kasseta belgisi: 'Listen and fill in the missing words. Then, use the prompts to act out similar dialogues in pairs.'
   1 A: I'm so 1) ...... I didn't MEET YOU FOR LUNCH. I was REALLY TIRED. B: Never mind. That's all right. • come to your wedding/ill • make it to your party/out of town
   2 A: Sorry I 2) ...... PHONE YOU last night. I was TOO BUSY. B: That's okay. It doesn't 3) ...... . • wash your shirt/too tired • take the dog out/exhausted
   3 A: I'm afraid I can't HELP YOU WITH THE DISHES. I haven't finished MY HOMEWORK yet. B: Don't 4) ...... about it. • go to the supermarket/my work • help you wash the car/cooking
• Pushti nuqta va to'q sariq 'Vocabulary Revision Game'.
23) 'In teams, use the words/phrases below to make sentences. Each correct sentence gets one point.' Qiya: guided tours, deep in thought, drown, except for, colleagues, deserted beach, rocking from side to side, alive, tide, benefit from, to his horror, grab, sink, help him to safety, shook his hand
• Katta to'q sariq 'Pronunciation'.
24) a) Kasseta belgisi: 'Listen and tick the sound you hear. Listen again and repeat.' Ikki jadval, ustunlar /ɔː/ va /ɒ/: saw, was, more, got, want, walk | lost, your, on, watch, course, floor
    b) 'Listen and repeat.' 1 I SAW your WATCH. It WAS ON the FLOOR. 2 I haven't GOT it any MORE. I LOST it. 3 We WANT to WALK, of COURSE.

O'NG USTUN:
• Katta to'q sariq 'Writing' va qavsda '(a story)'.
• TO'Q SARIQ ChIZIQLI QUTI: 'When we write A STORY NARRATING A FRIGHTENING EXPERIENCE we can divide our composition into five paragraphs. In the FIRST PARAGRAPH, we set the scene. We write about WHO WAS INVOLVED IN THE STORY, WHEN and WHERE IT HAPPENED, and WHAT happened first. We continue in the SECOND, THIRD and FOURTH PARAGRAPHS, writing the events in the order they happened. In the LAST PARAGRAPH, we WRITE WHAT HAPPENED IN THE END and how the people in the story FELT. We normally use PAST TENSES in such pieces of writing.'
25) Kasseta belgisi: 'Read the notes and try to put them in order, then listen and check. Finally, talk about the climbers' experience.' Qorli tog' fonida alpinist surati; BESh QAYD (yirtiq qog'oz, katakchali A-E):
   A: - snow block entrance to cave - trapped in cave - freezing cold - scared - radio for help
   B: - Bob & Ian - steep, dangerous mountain - experienced climbers - stop and rest in small cave
   C: - make instant soup - light small stove - rumbling noise - snow and ice fall
   D: - three hours later rescuers arrive - take six hours to dig them out - rescuers explain: small avalanche
   E: - helicopter take them to Rescue Centre - rescuers ask: "Give up climbing?" - Ian: "No - but not go in caves!"
26) 'Your teacher has asked you to write a composition entitled 'Trapped in the Snow' (120-150 words). Use the information in Ex. 25, as well as the plan below, to write your story.'
   DAFTAR: Pushti 'Plan'. Introduction - Para 1: set the scene (who-when-where-what). Main Body - Paras 2-4: develop the story (events before the main event/the main event itself). Conclusion - Para 5: end the story.
• Katta to'q sariq 'Words of Wisdom'. 'Read these sentences. What do they mean?' To'q sariq chiziqli quti: • Hasty climbers have sudden falls. • Any port in a storm. • It's easy to be wise after the event.

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '59'.

exercises.explanationUz:
KEChIRIM SO'RASh VA QABUL QILISh.


TO'LIQ DIALOGLAR:

  1 A: I'm so SORRY I didn't meet you
       for lunch. I was really tired.
    B: Never mind. That's all right.

  2 A: Sorry I DIDN'T phone you last
       night. I was too busy.
    B: That's okay. It doesn't MATTER.

  3 A: I'm afraid I can't help you
       with the dishes. I haven't
       finished my homework yet.
    B: Don't WORRY about it.


⚠ KEChIRIM SO'RASh:

  "I'm so sorry (that) I didn't ..."
  "Sorry I didn't ..."
  "I'm afraid I can't ..."
  ⚠ Har doim SABAB qo'shiladi:
  'I was really tired.'


⚠ KEChIRIMNI QABUL QILISh:

  'Never mind.' - Hechqisi yo'q.
  "That's all right." - Bo'ladi.
  "That's okay." - Mayli.
  "It doesn't matter." - Muhim emas.
  "Don't worry about it." - Xavotir
     olma.


⚠ 'NEVER MIND':

  = hechqisi yo'q, e'tibor berma.
  ⚠ Juda keng tarqalgan ibora.


⚠ "IT DOESN'T MATTER":

  ⚠ 'matter' bu yerda FE'L = ahamiyati
  bo'lmoq.
  ⚠ "What's the matter?" (50-bet) da
  'matter' - OT.


⚠ 'TO MAKE IT TO':

  = yetib bormoq, ulgurmoq.
  ⚠ "I couldn't make it to your
  party" = ziyofatingga kelolmadim.


⚠ 'OUT OF TOWN':

  = shaharda emas, safarda.


⚠ 'EXHAUSTED':

  = juda charchagan.
  ⚠ 'tired' < 'exhausted'.

exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI 'O' TOVUShI.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  /ɔː/ - UZUN 'o'                 ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  saw /sɔː/, more /mɔː/,
  walk /wɔːk/, your /jɔː/,
  course /kɔːs/, floor /flɔː/

  ⚠ Uzun, og'iz yumaloq.
  ⚠ Imlosi turlicha: aw, or, al, our,
  oor - lekin TOVUSh bir xil!


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  /ɒ/ - QISQA 'o'                 ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  was /wɒz/, got /ɡɒt/,
  want /wɒnt/, lost /lɒst/,
  on /ɒn/, watch /wɒtʃ/

  ⚠ Qisqa, keskin.


⚠ 'WAS' va 'WANT' - 'A' HARFI BILAN:

  'w' dan keyingi 'a' ko'pincha /ɒ/
  deb o'qiladi: was, want, watch,
  wash, what.


⚠ 'WALK' - 'L' O'QILMAYDI:

  /wɔːk/ - 'vok'.
  ⚠ 'talk' /tɔːk/ ham shunday.


⚠ 'COURSE' va 'COARSE':

  Bir xil o'qiladi /kɔːs/.
  ⚠ 'of course' = albatta.

UCh GAP - IKKI TOVUSh ARALASh.

  1 I SAW /ɔː/ your /ɔː/ WATCH /ɒ/.
    It WAS /ɒ/ ON /ɒ/ the FLOOR /ɔː/.
  2 I haven't GOT /ɒ/ it any MORE
    /ɔː/. I LOST /ɒ/ it.
  3 We WANT /ɒ/ to WALK /ɔː/, of
    COURSE /ɔː/.


⚠ 'ANY MORE':

  = endi, boshqa.
  ⚠ "I haven't got it any more" =
  endi menda yo'q.

sentences.en: I saw your watch. It was on the floor.
I haven't got it any more. I lost it.
We want to walk, of course.

exercises.instructionEn: When we write a story narrating a frightening experience we can divide our composition into five paragraphs.
exercises.instructionUz: Qo'rqinchli voqea haqida hikoya yozganda inshoni besh xatboshiga bo'lishimiz mumkin.
exercises.explanationUz:
HIKOYa YoZISh QOIDASI.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  BESh XATBOShI                   ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  1) SAHNANI O'RNATISh:
     KIM ishtirok etdi, QAChON,
     QAYERDA, NIMA birinchi bo'ldi

  2-4) VOQEALAR - bo'lgan tartibda

  5) OXIRI - nima bilan tugadi,
     odamlar NIMA HIS QILDI


⚠ ZAMONLAR:

  PAST TENSES:
    past simple - asosiy voqealar
    past continuous - fon, jarayon
    past perfect - oldingi voqealar


⚠ 'TO NARRATE':

  = hikoya qilmoq.
  ⚠ 'a narrator' = hikoyachi.


⚠ 'TO SET THE SCENE':

  = sahnani o'rnatmoq (kim, qachon,
  qayerda).


⚠ 'INVOLVED':

  = ishtirok etgan.
  ⚠ 'to be involved IN' = ... da
  ishtirok etmoq.


⚠ 58-BETDAGI 'A NARROW ESCAPE' -
  NAMUNA: aynan shu tuzilishda.

points.en: In the first paragraph, we set the scene. We write about who was involved in the story, when and where it happened, and what happened first.
points.uz: Birinchi xatboshida sahnani o'rnatamiz. Hikoyada kim ishtirok etgani, qachon va qayerda bo'lgani, birinchi nima bo'lgani haqida yozamiz.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'to set the scene' = sahnani o'rnatmoq.
⚠ KIM-QAChON-QAYERDA-NIMA.

points.en: We continue in the second, third and fourth paragraphs, writing the events in the order they happened.
points.uz: Ikkinchi, uchinchi va to'rtinchi xatboshilarda voqealarni bo'lgan tartibda yozib davom etamiz.

points.en: In the last paragraph, we write what happened in the end and how the people in the story felt.
points.uz: Oxirgi xatboshida oxirida nima bo'lgani va hikoyadagi odamlar nima his qilganini yozamiz.

points.en: We normally use past tenses in such pieces of writing.
points.uz: Bunday yozuvlarda odatda o'tgan zamonlarni ishlatamiz.
points.noteUz: ⚠ past simple, past continuous, past perfect.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the notes and try to put them in order, then listen and check.
exercises.instructionUz: Qaydlarni o'qing va tartibga qo'yishga harakat qiling, so'ng tinglab tekshiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'G'RI TARTIB: B → C → A → D → E

  1 B - Bob va Ian, tajribali
      alpinistlar, tik xavfli tog',
      kichik g'orda dam olish
      (SAHNA: kim, qayerda)
  2 C - sho'rva tayyorlash, pechka,
      gumburlash, qor va muz tushadi
      (VOQEA BOShLANIShI)
  3 A - qor g'or kirishini to'sadi,
      qamalib qolish, sovuq, qo'rquv,
      radio orqali yordam
      (ASOSIY VOQEA)
  4 D - uch soatdan keyin
      qutqaruvchilar, olti soat kovlash,
      kichik qor ko'chkisi
      (QUTQARISh)
  5 E - vertolyot, Qutqaruv markazi,
      "tashlaysizmi?" - "Yo'q, lekin
      g'orga kirmayman!"
      (OXIRI, his-tuyg'u)


⚠ 'TRAPPED':

  = qamalib qolgan.
  ⚠ 'a trap' = tuzoq.


⚠ 'AN AVALANCHE':

  = qor ko'chkisi.
  ⚠ O'qilishi /ˈævəlɑːnʃ/.


⚠ 'A STOVE':

  = pechka (sayohat uchun kichik).
  ⚠ 'to light a stove' = pechkani
  yoqmoq.


⚠ 'RUMBLING':

  = gumburlash.


⚠ 'TO DIG OUT':

  = kovlab chiqarmoq.
  ⚠ dig - dug - dug.


⚠ 'TO GIVE UP':

  = tashlamoq, voz kechmoq.
  ⚠ 'give up climbing' = alpinizmni
  tashlamoq.


⚠ 'STEEP':

  = tik (qiya).


⚠ 'FREEZING COLD':

  = muzday sovuq.

exercises.explanationUz:
REJA:

  Introduction
    Para 1: set the scene
    (who-when-where-what)
  Main Body
    Paras 2-4: develop the story
    (events before the main event /
     the main event itself)
  Conclusion
    Para 5: end the story


⚠ 'ENTITLED':

  = ... deb nomlangan.
  ⚠ 'a composition entitled ...' =
  ... nomli insho.


⚠ 'TO DEVELOP THE STORY':

⚠ ZAMONLAR NAMUNADA:

  past simple - 'stopped', 'heard'

structure.hintUz: kim (Bob va Ian), qayerda (tik tog'), nima (g'orda dam)
structure.exampleEn: Bob and Ian were experienced climbers. One cold winter day, they were climbing a steep, dangerous mountain when they stopped to rest in a small cave.
They lit a small stove and started making some instant soup. Suddenly, they heard a rumbling noise, and snow and ice began to fall outside.

structure.hintUz: qor kirishni to'sadi, qamalib qolish, radio
structure.exampleEn: Within seconds, the snow had blocked the entrance to the cave and they were trapped inside. It was freezing cold and they were very scared, so they radioed for help.

structure.hintUz: uch soat, olti soat kovlash, qor ko'chkisi
structure.exampleEn: Three hours later, the rescuers arrived. It took them six hours to dig the two men out. The rescuers explained that there had been a small avalanche.
A helicopter took Bob and Ian to the Rescue Centre. When the rescuers asked them if they were going to give up climbing, Ian said, "No - but we're never going into caves again!"

modelAnswers: Bob and Ian were experienced climbers. One cold winter day, they were climbing a steep, dangerous mountain when they stopped to rest in a small cave.
They lit a small stove and started making some instant soup. Suddenly, they heard a rumbling noise, and snow and ice began to fall outside.
Within seconds, the snow had blocked the entrance to the cave and they were trapped inside. It was freezing cold and they were very scared, so they radioed for help.
Three hours later, the rescuers arrived. It took them six hours to dig the two men out. The rescuers explained that there had been a small avalanche.
A helicopter took Bob and Ian to the Rescue Centre. When the rescuers asked them if they were going to give up climbing, Ian said, "No - but we're never going into caves again!"
modelAnswersUz: Bob va Ian tajribali alpinistlar edi. Sovuq qish kunlaridan birida ular tik, xavfli toqqa chiqayotgan edilar, kichik g'orda dam olish uchun to'xtashdi.
Ular kichik pechka yoqib, tez tayyor sho'rva pishira boshlashdi. To'satdan gumburlagan ovoz eshitildi va tashqarida qor va muz tusha boshladi.
Bir necha soniyada qor g'or kirishini to'sib qo'ydi va ular ichkarida qamalib qolishdi. Muzday sovuq edi va ular juda qo'rqishdi, shuning uchun radio orqali yordam chaqirishdi.
Uch soatdan keyin qutqaruvchilar yetib kelishdi. Ikki odamni kovlab chiqarish uchun olti soat ketdi. Qutqaruvchilar kichik qor ko'chkisi bo'lganini tushuntirishdi.
Vertolyot Bob va Ianni Qutqaruv markaziga olib bordi. Qutqaruvchilar alpinizmni tashlaysizlarmi deb so'raganda, Ian: "Yo'q, lekin boshqa hech qachon g'orga kirmaymiz!" - dedi.

exercises.instructionEn: Read these sentences. What do they mean?
exercises.instructionUz: Bu gaplarni o'qing. Ular nimani anglatadi?
exercises.explanationUz:
UCh MAQOL - XAVF VA EhTIYoTKORLIK
HAQIDA.

⚠ 'HASTY':
  = shoshqaloq.
  ⚠ 'haste' = shoshqaloqlik.

⚠ 'A PORT':
  = port, bandargoh.

⚠ 'WISE':
  = dono, aqlli.
  ⚠ 'wisdom' = donolik ('Words of
  Wisdom').

items.answerEn: It means that if you do things too quickly without care, you will fail or have an accident.
items.answerUz: Ya'ni ishni ehtiyotsiz, shoshib qilsang, muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchraysan. (O'zbekchada: 'Shoshgan qiz erga yolchimas'.)

items.answerEn: It means that in a difficult situation, you accept any help or solution, even if it isn't perfect.
items.answerUz: Ya'ni qiyin vaziyatda mukammal bo'lmasa ham har qanday yordam yoki yechimni qabul qilasan.

items.en: It's easy to be wise after the event.
items.answerEn: It means that it is easy to say what should have been done after something has already happened.
items.answerUz: Ya'ni voqea bo'lib o'tgandan keyin nima qilish kerak edi deyish oson. (O'zbekchada: 'Ish o'tgandan keyin aql keladi'.)

patterns.formula: I'm so sorry I didn't [fe'l]. I was [sabab]. - Never mind.
patterns.exampleEn: I'm so sorry I didn't meet you for lunch. I was really tired. - Never mind. That's all right.
patterns.exampleUz: Tushlikda uchrashmaganim uchun juda uzr. Juda charchagan edim. - Hechqisi yo'q.

patterns.formula: I'm afraid I can't [fe'l]. I haven't [3-ShAKL] ... yet. - Don't worry about it.
patterns.exampleEn: I'm afraid I can't help you with the dishes. I haven't finished my homework yet. - Don't worry about it.
patterns.exampleUz: Afsuski, idishlarga yordam berolmayman. Hali uy vazifamni tugatmadim. - Xavotir olma.

patterns.exampleEn: They were climbing a steep mountain when they stopped to rest in a cave.
patterns.exampleUz: Ular tik toqqa chiqayotgan edilar, g'orda dam olish uchun to'xtashdi.
patterns.explanationUz: ⚠ Hikoya sahnasi: past continuous + past simple.

patterns.exampleEn: It took them six hours to dig the two men out.
patterns.exampleUz: Ikki odamni kovlab chiqarish uchun olti soat ketdi.
